content.name: Chain
entries: As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can wrap a Chain around an unwilling creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52}, {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52}, or {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition if you succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until it escapes. Escaping the Chain requires the creature to make a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|SRD52}) check as an action. Bursting the Chain requires a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check as an action.
